snippet.title: ACA NEOGEO The King of Fighters 2001 (PS4) | K' Team & Solo Play Broadcast Playthrough (12/14/2023)
snippet.description:
ACA NEOGEO series (PS4), "The King of Fighters 2001" K' Team (NESTS saga Hero Team) team play mode broadcast playthroughs, (Level 3 or 4 difficulty) with possible caravan & Hi Score mode gameplay, & maybe possible Solo Play playthrough. (broadcasted) (12/14/2023)

I was going to wait til next week instead for this game, but I couldn't resisted the urge once more for getting started on a whole new game for my ACA NEOGEO series collection on my PS4, (also on my Switch too) The King of Fighters 2001!!

KOF 2001 is both the 3rd and last chapter of the NESTS saga, since around '99, 2000, & 2001. This is it final chapter of the special 4-on-4 "Striker" rules, theh its back to its traditional 3-on-3 team rules once in 2002 & so on todays. Now with K' Team plays as the main hero team for the NESTS saga, now its time for a showdown against the mastermind of the vileous schemes of NESTS, an sinister corporation known for both Kyo clones by Krizalid in '99 & Clone Zero & Kula incidents in 2000.
